name: Esperanto
description: The International Language, taught in the order and manner of Kellerman's 1910 grammar: a fully regular alphabet, then the parts of speech marked by their endings, each rule explained rather than merely stated.
attribution: Grammar and reading matter adapted from Ivy Kellerman Reed, A Complete Grammar of Esperanto (1910), Project Gutenberg #7787 — public domain. Spelling modernised from the x-method of that edition to the diacritics ĉ ĝ ĥ ĵ ŝ ŭ.
